messages.content: what if train didnot travel to the station,its route has changed

If the train did not travel to the station because its route has changed, you can file for a refund. You need to file a Ticket Deposit Receipt (TDR) online within 72 hours from the scheduled departure time of the train at your boarding station (Page 3).

messages.searched_as: What is the refund policy if the train did not travel to the station due to a change in its route?

messages.content: i booked a bunch of tickets for family,but some of them are not confirmed,what should i do now

If you booked a bunch of tickets for your family and some of them are not confirmed, you should cancel the tickets online. For the confirmed passengers, you will receive a full refund minus a cancellation charge of ₹20 + GST per passenger, as long as you cancel the tickets online up to four hours before the scheduled departure of the train (Page 2). If the tickets are still on the waiting list after the first charting, they will be automatically cancelled, and you will receive a full refund without any cancellation charges (Page 1).
